tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search SkyBuyFly's price comparison of airport duty-free shops by product name, brand or category. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one SkyBuyFly product by its product_id: its description and size, every stored offer per airport shop (the shop's own price, the price in the requested currency, when it was observed, a link to the SkyBuyFly deal page) and similar products. Relevant when a traveller wants every airport and shop

tools.name: get_live_prices
tools.description: Check a product's prices live at every airport shop that sells it: SkyBuyFly opens each shop's page now and confirms the current price. tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get a product's observed prices per airport over time: SkyBuyFly's 50 most recent observations (the answer says which dates they cover), as each airport's price changes, with the lowest and latest price. tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.description: Find the SkyBuyFly product that carries a barcode (the digits of an EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13 or GTIN-14, e.g. read from a box or a photo) with its price at each airport shop that has an offer for that code, and when it was seen. tools.name: get_featured_products
tools.description: Get SkyBuyFly's featured airport duty-free products with their airport prices, and the most popular catalogue categories. Not personalised. Relevant when a traveller wants inspiration or asks what is popular at duty free.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: List the airports whose duty-free shops SkyBuyFly compares: IATA code, name, city and the shops' store domains, optionally only those matching a text (code, name or city). Relevant for finding an airport's IATA code or answering which airports are covered.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List the currencies SkyBuyFly shows prices in (ISO 4217 code, name, symbol). Every price tool takes one of these codes as currency.

tools.name: get_catalogue_stats
tools.description: Get the size and freshness of SkyBuyFly's price comparison catalogue: the number of products, the number of airports and when the figures were generated. Relevant when asked how much SkyBuyFly covers.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_barcode" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
